# Product requirements

Owner: <decision owner>
Status: draft
Canonical brief: <path/link owning OUT-001 and RQ-001 IDs; this PRD owns them only
if no brief already exists>

## Problem and audience

Link the reviewed problem and audience. Expand the canonical brief only where
additional rationale is useful; small work may keep that brief alone.

## Evidence and decisions

- Observed evidence: <source, observation and limits>
- User decisions: <source and actual scope/authorization>
- Hypotheses: <unverified belief and needed evidence>

## Options and rationale

Compare feasible approaches and doing nothing when meaningful. Explain impact,
evidence confidence, effort and dependencies without fabricated numeric scores.

## Outcomes and acceptance

| Requirement | Outcome | Observable criterion | Source / proposed or confirmed / verification status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| RQ-001 | OUT-001 | <reuse canonical criterion; link rather than duplicate its authority> | <evidence or planned check; retain unknowns> |

Do not present unresolved formats, headers, error behavior or success metrics as
approved facts. Keep outcome and requirement IDs stable in downstream references.

## Scope and exclusions

Bound the next increment, preserved behavior and excluded adjacent work.

## Constraints and risks

Identify consumers, compatibility, migration/recovery and verification needs.
UI/UX work is optional when the increment changes interaction. Fixture evidence
is not live qualification, user preference or a measured business outcome.

## Open questions

Name material unknowns, contradictions, decision owners and resolution methods.
Keep actual approval separate from a recommended next step.

## Links

Canonical brief and evidence, applicable design, formal specification, tracker work.
Use needs-spec and the configured formal provider before implementation where
required. Formal specifications own behavior; this PRD owns product rationale.

Decision: <proceed|investigate|stop> — <reason and smallest next action; proceed
within existing authorization once material constraints are resolved, investigate
missing evidence or contradictions, stop declined/duplicate/out-of-scope work>
